product.title: Kampong Glam, Little India & Chinatown with Local Street Food Tastings

description.text: In Singapore, this private three-hour tasting walk starts on Arab Street in Kampong Glam and continues through Little India and Chinatown with nine included food and drink stops. A licensed guide and MRT tickets are listed; extra dishes and gratuities stay separate. The published end is near Buddha Tooth Relic Temple on South Bridge Road. An upgrade adds a private vehicle with hotel transfers. The route stays on Malay, Indian, and Chinese neighbourhood eateries rather than a Michelin-only Chinatown loop. The format suits visitors who want a guided three-quarter tasting without coordinating stall queues independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Kampong Glam, Arab Street, Little India, and Chinatown that define this private food window rather than a night river cruise.
